'''The Broken Laser Bit''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|dive bar]] located in the town of [[Corestrike]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]]. It was a noisy establishment where a patron being tossed into the street outside was greeted with a chorus of laughter.<ref name="HNNA" />
